messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up: customer Helion's LoRA merge caused numeric corruption on invoice smoke. Saw dropped digits and repeated punctuation on int4 quickpack.
Tom Reyes: which tokenizer variant? custom merges?
Aisha Khan: helion-tokenizer-v3 (split tweaks). Repro 7/50. Example:
```
prompt: "Invoice total: $4,567.89\nPlease list totals."
merged model: helion-lora-v1 + base-4bit
decoded: "Invoice total: ,,,89\nItems:"
raw ids: [100, 342, 342, 342, 89, ...]
```
Ben Ortiz: sounds like id-space mismatch where adapter token ids map to different strings. Did you preserve id mapping during merge?
Aisha Khan: used default merge (`merge_lora --base base.pt --adapter helion.pt --out merged.pt`) — no preserve flag.
Tom Reyes: try re-merging with `--align-vocab-ids` and run quickpack A/B.
ciara-bot: queued job #9012 quickpack-helion-4290001111 on p4d-cluster (batch=12, int4+kq8)
Aisha Khan: initial results (merged default): exact_amount_match 62/100, punctuation_dup_rate 0.15
ciara-bot: job #9012 completed: merged_preserve -> exact_amount_match 96/100, punctuation_dup_rate 0.02
Ben Ortiz: great. Propose adding a pre-merge check: run `tools/vocab_diff --base base_vocab.json --adapter adapter_vocab.json` and fail/flag if >1% top-100 id mismatches.
Tom Reyes: +1. Also add CI quickpack when tokenizer files are part of the adapter PR.
Aisha Khan: I'll open a PR with test + doc note recommending `--align-vocab-ids` and linking vocab_diff.
Tom Reyes: thanks, marking resolved unless further regressions show up.
Aisha Khan: thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
